title: A letter from Grandma Fatima
summary: Omar's grandmother can't write any more, so Lina writes her words down.

items.example: My eyes aren't good enough to write.
Here is some advice from an old woman.
The whole family is going to be here.
I pray for you every night.

sections.title: Read and listen
sections.heading: My dear Omar,
sections.intro: Grandma Fatima speaks, and Lina writes. Then Lina reads the letter to Omar on a video call.
paragraphs: My eyes aren't good enough to write letters any more, so Lina is writing down my words. She is laughing at my English, but I don't care.
I remember the day you left for America. You were very quiet at the airport, and I didn't cry. I cried at home, for a whole week.
You were always brave, even when you were a little boy.
Here is some advice from an old woman. Eat well. Winter in Boston is too cold for a boy from Amman, so wear your hat.
Call your mother every Friday, not only on holidays. And be kind to your patients. A kind nurse is better than good medicine.
Next summer, when you come home, I'm going to cook maqluba for the whole family. Kareem, Hala and little Adam are going to come from Dubai.
The house is going to be too small and too loud, and it's going to be perfect.
I pray for you every night.
